completion_data.completion_summary: Created /vet command-skill-agent triplet for the cslib extension: vet.md command with multi-task syntax, skill-cslib-vet with git history file extraction, and cslib-vet-agent with full CI pipeline, 5-category standards analysis, and interactive fix task creation following the 8-component multi-task creation standard.

memory_candidates.content: The /vet pattern for CSLib quality gates: command parses task numbers -> skill extracts changed files via `git log --grep='task N:' | xargs git show --name-only | grep '^Cslib/'` -> agent reads files, runs CI, checks against CONTRIBUTING.md/NOTATION.md/ORGANISATION.md/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, presents violations via AskUserQuestion multiSelect, creates cslib-type fix tasks with minimization principle (group by module/category, not per-violation). Vet is orthogonal to task lifecycle — no status changes on vetted tasks.

Agents invoked via Agent tool (not Task tool) CAN use AskUserQuestion reliably — the foreground/background split documented in multi-task-creation-standard.md applies only to agents spawned via Task tool. This simplifies designs that need interactive confirmation inside subagents.
